resources.string: A provider is a person, community or company that uses its model account to help you use an agent. After binding you use their compute. They can see your Tadolio number and message you. You can unbind or block them at any time.
There are no providers yet. Choose “Help your own people” under “Be a miner” in the side menu to become the first.
Reductions apply immediately to everyone. Increases apply to new bindings. Existing users must agree again.
